{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders: look for revenue values around 999,999.99
# Use a tolerance to catch both '999999.99' and '999,999.99'
qa_threshold = 999000  # Any revenue > 999,000 is suspicious
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] > qa_threshold]

print("Number of suspicious revenue entries (likely QA orders):", len(qa_orders))
print("Values of suspicious entries:", qa_orders['revenue_clean'].unique())

# Show their status
print("Status of suspicious entries:", qa_orders['status'].unique())"}
